title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 295 (Power to order payment into bank)

content.overview: The Tribunal may order the company liquidator to pay moneys received into the public account, and may disallow retention.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The Tribunal may order the company liquidator to pay moneys received into the public account, and may disallow retention.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The rule protects the estate. A liquidator who retains money without authority is accountable. The section is a custody rule, not a distribution rule.
